summary: Existing PowerRename Uppercase/Lowercase transforms fail supplementary-plane and context-sensitive Unicode case mappings.

judgment.rationale: The issue isolates two Unicode failures in existing case transforms. The current source applies locale wide-character mappings independently, whereas the referenced PR adds an ICU full-string helper but confines it to the new SentenceCase mode. A focused extension of the helper to existing modes matches the observed symptoms without requiring more reporter diagnostics.
evidence: The live report gives two specific PowerRename 0.103 reproductions: U+10428 remains lowercase under Uppercase, and final Greek sigma becomes ordinary sigma under Lowercase.
At PowerToys main commit 084281ef6b137aa47a1e6a8e1e7bf79b0fe0378e, Helpers.cpp GetTransformedFileName uses std::transform with towupper/towlower in the existing case branches.
PR #51982 is open with changes requested; its current diff adds ChangeUnicodeCase and Unicode tests only for the new SentenceCase branch, not the existing Uppercase/Lowercase paths.
The upstream issue is open, has no comments, and has no separate linked fix; a search of MuyuanMS/PowerToys for 52211 found no fork issue or PR mirror.
PR #51982 author comment on 2026-11-18 says the new Unicode helper is available for other casing paths in separate fixes; the current diff still scopes its use to SentenceCase.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve or revise the focused design before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The open linked PR #51982 does not cover this existing PowerRename path; no separate upstream fix or fork mirror was found.

proposed_fixes.title: Apply Unicode-aware casing to existing Uppercase and Lowercase modes
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The existing Uppercase and Lowercase branches map individual wchar_t values with towupper/towlower. On Windows wchar_t is a UTF-16 code unit, so supplementary characters such as U+10428 are not mapped as one scalar value, and per-character lowercase mapping cannot apply context-sensitive Greek final sigma. The ICU helper added by PR #51982 is used only by the new SentenceCase branch.
plan: Use the Unicode case-mapping helper for the selected stem or complete name in Uppercase and Lowercase, preserving the existing folder, filename-only, extension-only, and extension-preservation rules.
Map the full casing segment so context-sensitive mappings see their surrounding text and supplementary code points are decoded as complete characters.
Add focused native regression tests for Deseret U+10428 uppercase, Greek ΦΩΣ lowercase, existing ASCII behavior, and extension-only behavior.
verification: Run the focused PowerRename native tests in PowerRenameManagerTests.cpp.
Verify the issue repro: U+10428 becomes U+10400 under Uppercase and ΦΩΣ becomes φως under Lowercase; the existing extension behavior remains unchanged.

confidence.rationale: Both failures have explicit public repros and the current source path directly matches the reported limitations; the helper needed for Unicode mapping already exists in the referenced PR.
